'''Agent Deryl''' is an [[SI:7]] agent assigned to investigate the island of [[Balor]]. During the course of this mission, he and nine fellow agents were discovered while surveying the perimeter around the [[Croaking Plateau]] and were taken captive. While he was held in an abandoned inn by [[Sorrowmore Lake]], three of his companions - [[Agent Cherys|Agents Cherys]], [[Agent Flynn|Flynn]] and [[Elroy]] - were instead dragged to a cave beneath [[Stormreaver Spire]] to be experimented on by the Stormreavers.
